content.claim: Critical path identified: 27 calendar days (18-19 work days) with 3-5 day slack buffer for blockers. Sequential execution required for solo developer. Foundation tasks (DB Migrations → Event Bus → Background Jobs) are hard blockers for all Week 2+ work.
evidence: 576-line dependency graph document with 4 Mermaid Gantt charts
5 risk areas identified with mitigation strategies
Parallel work opportunities quantified (6 days deferrable)
content.critical_path: DB Migrations (Day 1) → Event Bus (Day 2) → Background Jobs (Day 5) → Warranty APIs (Days 7-9) → E2E Testing (Day 23) → Security Audit (Day 24) → Deployment (Days 25-27)

risk_areas.name: Home Assistant Webhook Validation Unknown
risk_areas.mitigation: Spike on HA API requirements Day 9 PM (2-4 hours). Have fallback if unreachable.

risk_areas.name: OWASP Dependency Scan Failures
risk_areas.mitigation: Run audit baseline Day 1. Update dependencies early Week 1. Schedule audit Day 24 (not Day 27).

risk_areas.name: Database Migration Edge Cases
risk_areas.mitigation: Test rollback immediately after Day 1. Validate SQLite foreign key behavior.

risk_areas.name: Playwright E2E Setup Complexity
risk_areas.mitigation: Start E2E Day 22 (not Day 23). Use templates. Pre-build test cases.

risk_areas.name: Production Deployment Issues
risk_areas.mitigation: Full rehearsal Day 25 on staging. Automated smoke tests. Rollback drill.

weekly_gates.go_criteria: DB migrations + Event Bus tested, Background Jobs registered, Week 1 acceptance 90%+ passing
weekly_gates.no_go_criteria: DB migrations unstable OR Event Bus failing tests

weekly_gates.go_criteria: Warranty APIs stable, HA integration working, Integration tests 80%+ passing
weekly_gates.no_go_criteria: Warranty APIs failing tests OR HA webhook unreachable

weekly_gates.go_criteria: Sale workflow complete, Notifications 90%+ done, Offline mode working, E2E skeleton ready
weekly_gates.no_go_criteria: Sale workflow failing OR notification system unreliable

weekly_gates.go_criteria: All features deployed, E2E tests passing, Security audit passed, Post-deploy validation OK
weekly_gates.no_go_criteria: Post-deploy validation failing OR critical security issues found

key_bottlenecks: DB Migrations Day 1 (zero slack - blocks everything)
Event Bus Day 2 (zero slack - blocks jobs + async)
Background Jobs Day 5 (zero slack - blocks notification flows)
Warranty APIs Days 7-9 (critical - foundation for Week 2+)
recommendations_for_S4H10: Deployment checklist should include pre-deployment 'dress rehearsal' on staging (Day 25)
Post-deployment validation (Day 27) is NOT optional - builds in 1-day contingency
Rollback procedure must be tested before production deploy
Monitor first 24 hours of production deployment actively (have developer on-call Dec 9)
Riviera pilot setup is optional - defer if deployment takes longer than expected
content.confidence_rationale: High confidence based on detailed task specifications in planning document. Medium confidence in HA integration (unknown requirements). Risk areas quantified and mitigated.
